description: Local document parsing to text/markdown (PDF, Office, images, CSV).
fullDescription:
## OVERVIEW ##
Docling parses documents into clean, structured text/markdown, running entirely locally — no cloud service and no data leaving the machine.

Supported inputs include:
- PDF (including scanned pages, via OCR)
- Microsoft Office: DOCX, XLSX, PPTX
- Images (PNG, JPEG, TIFF) via OCR
- HTML, Markdown, AsciiDoc, CSV

It exposes a REST API (docling-serve) plus an optional UI playground. This build uses the CPU image, so it does not claim the GPU.
